g.text: Revision A draft | 22 November 2026 | Same-name labels are electrically connected.
Separate 5.1k CC pull-downs. USB-C data and power; no PD negotiation.
U4 limits turn-on slew before downstream bulk capacitors. Verify inrush on hardware.
16 MHz resonator includes load capacitors. AREF is decoupled, not tied to +5V.
A0 remains externally floating, as on the prototype, for the existing randomSeed call.
DTR falling edge resets U1 through C10. D1 clamps the positive reset pulse.
R8/R9 set a conservative starting volume. Tune by listening; do not assume a 3 W output.
Program bootloader and fuses through J2 before USB serial uploads can work.
Use Arduino Uno / ATmega328P / 16 MHz / Optiboot, 115200 baud.
Do not connect a powered ISP source and USB power together.
Bridge output: neither speaker pin connects to GND. Keep speaker pair short / twisted.
